claims.head: Active D vs. Forward-led
claims.body: On shots from defensemen, San Jose is one of the league’s best, but Boston is one of the worst. They’re about as far apart as two teams get. Watch the Sharks’ defensemen jump into the play.

SJS.head: Close, but the Bruins have the slight edge
SJS.body: Boston has been out-chancing opponents lately, but San Jose has home-ice advantage. The Sharks’ best way to tip it is keeping shots to a minimum.

BOS.head: Leaning the Bruins’ way
BOS.body: Boston has been out-chancing opponents lately, but San Jose has home-ice advantage. Still, it’s close: the Sharks can make it interesting if they keep shots to a minimum.

items.text: JJ Peterka has six goals in seven games against San Jose since 2023-24, most of them with Buffalo.
The Bruins have been without Jonathan Aspirot since Oct 3, and have had to make do without Michael Eyssimont all season.
